topic: Fractional Distillation Column Product Separation from Top to Bottom
questionText:
Arrange the petroleum refining fractions in order of increasing boiling point (from the top of the distillation column to the bottom residue):
(I) Petroleum gases (LPG: Propane, Butane; boiling below 40 degrees Celsius)
(II) Petrol / Gasoline (C5–C10; boiling between 40 and 175 degrees Celsius)
(III) Kerosene and Aviation Turbine Fuel (C10–C16; boiling between 175 and 275 degrees Celsius)
(IV) Diesel oil and Fuel oils (C16–C20; boiling between 250 and 350 degrees Celsius)

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

Hence Option C is correct.
